evidence: The track begins behind Sabine Hut and climbs very steeply and steadily to the bush edge.
Poles and cairns mark the route from here, which eventually drops off the eastern side of a high ridge of Mt Cedric (1,532 m) and onto Rotomaninitua/Lake Angelus.
up to 9 hours on the Mt Cedric Track via Sabine Hut

side_trips.name: Sunset Saddle and Travers Range
side_trips.quote: climb to Sunset Saddle and then traverse west for 10 min to the Travers Range

doubts: The description does not name the end explicitly; it says the route drops onto Rotomaninitua/Lake Angelus, and the walk name and DOC distance '6.8 km one way' put the end at Angelus Hut. The page does not say whether Mt Cedric Track (T4) or Mt Cedric Route (T3) is the map track followed (likely both, track then route), so no track is listed in via.
